segments.title: The Headlines
segments.strap: Hearts leave two players in Edinburgh as management explain reason…

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Good evening. Welcome to Hearts News 24 with the latest headlines from Tynecastle and beyond.

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Hearts have left two players behind in Edinburgh due to injury issues ahead of their European trip, as reported by the Edinburgh Evening News.

graphic.title: Hearts leave two players in Edinburgh as management explain reason for injury issues ahead of Trabzonspor tie

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Manager Wouter Vrancken has struck a bullish tone regarding Mo Salah while highlighting the real threats posed by Trabzonspor.

graphic.title: Wouter Vrancken bullish on Mo Salah as Hearts boss names real Trabzonspor threat

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Trabzonspor head coach Thomas Reis has urged caution ahead of the tie, comparing Hearts to Besiktas despite the weekend league defeat.

graphic.title: Trabzonspor coach urges caution on Hearts after Celtic result and compares them to Besiktas

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: The referee appointed for the European encounter has previously had controversial history with Hearts boss Wouter Vrancken.

graphic.title: Trabzonspor vs Hearts referee has controversial Wouter Vrancken history including red cards and accusations

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Let us head over to Kirsty Moffat in the Match Centre for a closer look at the numbers.

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: In their last outing, Hearts were beaten seven-one away against Celtic in the Scottish Premier League.

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: Hearts sit third in the Scottish Premier League on sixteen points, four points behind Rangers and two points above Dundee.

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: Up next, it is Trabzonspor against Hearts, UEFA Conference League, tomorrow at 5:45pm.

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: Welcome to the Transfer Centre. The transfer window is currently closed, and it reopens in seventy-two days.

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Supporters on Jambos Kickback continue to debate Wouter Vrancken's tactical system following the heavy defeat at Parkhead. Frustration remains evident around ongoing player injuries, though fans have praised Hearts Women for their comprehensive weekend victory.

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: That is all for this bulletin. Stay with us on Hearts News 24 as our coverage continues throughout the evening.
